outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution localization images, density maps, and cluster segmentation renderings — not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution localization images, density maps, and cluster segmentation renderings — not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters per cell is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray data points for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Cluster sizes are shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray data points for each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Proportion of clustered molecules per cell is shown as a scatter/dot plot with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray data points for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM localization and trajectory images, not a quantitative averaged plot.

The top histogram displays raw distribution of diffusion coefficients (not a mean/average summary), and the bottom mean square displacement plot is a line plot of individual trajectories over time; neither type requires overlaid individual points per the exemption rules.
Panel H shows representative trajectory maps, kymographs, and example trajectory traces, not a quantitative averaged plot.
